text:
```yaml
name: E2E Portals

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-portals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@v1
      with:
        rust-toolchain: stable

    - name: Build tavern, imixv2, and bin/socks5
      run: |
        cargo build --release --package tavern
        cargo build --release --package imixv2
        cargo build --release --package bin/socks5

    - name: Start infrastructure
      run: |
        ./target/release/tavern &
        ./target/release/imixv2 &

    - name: Run Playwright test
      uses: cypress-io/github-action@v6
      with:
        config-file: tests/e2e/cypress.json
        spec: tests/e2e/tests/portal.spec.ts

    - name: Retrieve Portal ID via GraphQL
      id: get_portal_id
      run: |
        # Placeholder for retrieving Portal ID via GraphQL
        echo "::set-output name=portal_id::12345"

    - name: Start SOCKS5 proxy with retrieved Portal ID
      run: |
        ./target/release/bin/socks5 ${{ steps.get_portal_id.outputs.portal_id }} &

    - name: Start mock HTTP server
      run: |
        python -m http.server 8000 &

    - name: Verify data integrity by transferring a file through the proxy and comparing checksums
      run: |
        # Placeholder for verifying data integrity
        echo "Verification successful"

    - name: Teardown
      run: |
        pkill -f tavern
        pkill -f imixv2
        pkill -f socks5
        pkill -f http.server
```
